title: ZeRO: what stays on the GPU
caption: The 112 GB replicated footprint decomposes as weights 14 GB, gradients 14 GB, optimizer 84 GB. ZeRO-1 removes the replicated optimizer (the fat target), ZeRO-2 the gradients, ZeRO-3 the weights. The 80 GB HBM line is crossed after the first stage; full sharding reaches 1.75 GB.

title: Speedup achieved, and the gap to ideal
caption: Each bar's total is ideal linear speedup for that worker count; the filled share is what the measured run achieved. BSP reaches 6.8 of 8 and 40.1 of 64; the stale-synchronous schedule at 64 workers relaxes the barrier and loses slightly more, 38.1 of 64.
